purpose: Read-only WBS review proposal based on G01-G10 goals, PAC01-PAC24 source policy crosswalk, latest reports/backlog/experiment cards. Parent computes final completion percentage.

source_basis.read_scope: G01-G10 goal statements and original success conditions.
Source PAC01-PAC24; source numbering differs from runtime PAC-01..15.
PAC source-to-runtime/code candidate crosswalk; static map, not proof.
Latest DEV-01..33 states and explicit unresolved gaps.
Historical unit/regression/deployment/PJ1 evidence and precise measurement limitations.
Offline reported baseline/final tests; final selected checks and Windows report.log WinError32 limitation.
Specific PJ1 managed identity, active/compliant, exact Linux profile/kernel checks, Node denial, approved Gateway TCP and IPv4/IPv6 loopback attempts.
E13-variant actual Claude managed/unmanaged test; logs, invalid scope, missing true stdio call, model self restraint, protocol/event gaps.
D-79 self-approval invalidation; ledger 744-800 excluded as governance success.
Actual SDK read, one manual shadow upload, automatic OS event delivery, no automatic stdio forwarding, managed UID/unconfined scope and evidence hashes.
E13 required direct stdio, IPv4/IPv6, unmanaged control and independent effect; status not_run.
Five application/DB state scenarios and dedicated database evidence; not host kernel proof.

mapping_rules.pac_ids: Use original PAC01-PAC24 as source policy IDs. Runtime PAC-01..15 are a different namespace; do not numeric-join without documented semantic crosswalk.
mapping_rules.subtasks: Exactly four proposed atomic tasks per each G01-G10; acceptance is scoped to that task.
mapping_rules.booleans: These are evidence-bounded suggested booleans from read-only report/source review only. `regression` is false because prior PASS was not rerun against a source hash matched to this WBS review; parent may independently compare report commit/source hash. `acceptance_complete` remains false for all proposed WBS items.
mapping_rules.historical_evidence: Report PASS is retained with its own date, source SHA/version and precise target. Do not describe as current-code PASS unless source hash/version matches. Static/source presence never equals test success.
mapping_rules.endpoint_scope: Managed UID/profile/kernel evidence applies to tested PJ1 account only; it does not establish all account, Windows, administrator or arbitrary-app control.
mapping_rules.telemetry: Manual process report, automatic kernel denial event and automated MCP stdio inventory are different channels. Current evidence: manual upload was received as shadow/suspected; kernel OS event auto-arrived; automatic stdio forwarding was false.
mapping_rules.invalid_evidence: D-79 self-approved 9-tool test is invalid as positive governance evidence; preserve for audit only. E13 card remains not_run and its variant is partial.
mapping_rules.hash_policy: Preserve source raw SHA-256 and sanitized projection SHA-256 separately. A hash of a report artifact is not proof that the live payload bytes exactly match the endpoint source without direct byte/hash comparison.
mapping_rules.evidence_dates: Evidence dates are attached only to the cited report or design artifact. Historical report PASS is not current-source PASS unless source SHA/revision matches this review branch.
mapping_rules.implementation_assessment: Each row has complete, partial_candidate, or not_implemented. Only complete maps to implementation=true; path/symbol existence alone is insufficient.
